Margaret Munce Durham Margaret Munce was born in Kent Co., DE sometime around 1816. She was the daughter of Robert Munce Sr. . Her mother's name is unknown but it was possibly also Margaret. Prior to her marriage to Joel Durham, Margaret appears to have had a child whose father is unknown. His exact birthdate is not clear but it appears he was later raised by Margaret's brother, Robert Munce, Jr. and his wife, Jemima Hansor. Isaiah Munce (1835-1905)married Elmira Carty Sometime before 1838 Margaret married Joel Durham who was born in Kent Co., DE in July 1818, the son of Elisha Durham and Hester Concilor. Margaret and Joel had the following children: Elisha Durham (October 1839- 17 July, 1894) Elisha is buried at Manship Church in Cheswold. Charles Durham (1842- ) George W. Durham ( 15 Aug. 1844 - 28 Feb. 1916) married Elizabeth George is buried at Manship Church in Cheswold. Elijah Durham (1845- ) married Louisa Greenage Amelia Durham (1848- ) Clayton Durham (16 July 1849 - 1924) married Melvina Carney Clayton is buried at Manship Church in Cheswold. Harriett Durham (10 Aug. 1851 - 22 Dec. 1920) married James Perry Carney Harriett is buried at the Fork Branch cemetary. John Durham (June 1853 - ) married Annie Durham William Durham (1856- ) Margaret died on 14 April, 1895 in Kent Co. Her death certificate lists her race as "mulatto", her age as "78 years" and her residence as "near Kenton". Her husband, Joel, went to live with Margaret's nephew, Isaiah Durham and his family in Little Creek Hundred. Joel died on 17 February 1909.
